Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a factual error in its "Updated Understanding" by incorrectly stating that "Bell Labs' headquarters is located in New Providence, New Jersey." This contradicts the explicit evidence provided in the previous step (Step 3), where the Nokia Bell Labs official locations page clearly listed "Murray Hill, New Jersey (HQ)" and the Wikipedia search results also confirmed Murray Hill. The Planner failed to accurately synthesize the retrieved data, hallucinating a different city (New Providence) instead of correctly identifying Murray Hill as the headquarters. This led to the final incorrect answer of "New Providence, New Jersey" instead of the correct "Murray Hill".
